meta.title: feat: optimize slot generation with inverted algorithm
meta.body_summary: Add an optimized slot generation algorithm for large team events (>10 members) using inverted approach with batching and feature flag, aiming to improve performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin delivered a functional algorithm change with CI passing and integration tests; maintainer closed in favor of other optimizations first.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 713 changed lines across 5 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, including algorithm refactor (~200 lines in util.ts) and significant test churn (~430 lines in added then deleted test file). As an algorithm performance PR, it was closed without merge because the maintainer prioritized other optimization approaches rather than merging this one.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer keithwillcode commented they are trying other optimizations first and will revisit this PR if it makes sense, indicating strategic deprioritization rather than functional rejection.
review_details.performance_claim: The inverted algorithm with batch processing of users in groups of 10 and short-circuiting aims to improve slot generation performance for teams with more than 10 members.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer deprioritized the optimization and closed the PR without merge, citing intent to pursue other performance improvements first.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin delivered a technically sound change with passing CI and integration tests, but the maintainer opted for a different optimization path, showing that agent-authored performance PRs may be deferred even when correct if they don't match current maintenance priorities.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarking data or before/after performance measurements were provided; the PR relies solely on narrative description and integration tests for correctness.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge after maintainer comment about prioritizing other optimizations.

core_change_summary.description: Added getAvailableSlotsOptimized() in util.ts that generates ideal slots first from event type settings, then processes users in batches of 10 with short-circuiting when minimum required users are met; added 'optimized-slot-generation' team feature flag in config.ts and hooks/index.ts; added integration test in getSchedule.test.ts verifying identical results between standard and optimized algorithms for a 10+ user round robin scenario.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The util.test.ts file was added with initial unit tests, then later deleted in favor of integration tests.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added optimized algorithm in util.ts and initial unit tests.
Additional commit: expanded unit tests for large team scenarios.
Feature flag commit: introduced team feature flag and replaced unit tests with integration test.
Refactor commit: removed weak unit test file per feedback.
Final commit: fixed TypeScript errors in feature flag implementation.
